message.reasoning:
Key issues: Kourou latitude stated as 45.05°N — actually ~5.2°N; likely typo but technical error. Inclination 87.79° at 600 km — plot shows ~97.8° at 600 km; the value 87.79° is wrong (retrograde SSO needs >90°). Contradiction: "retrograde" but inclination 87.79° is prograde. Also text says "which is also desirable" for low resolution — error. Wikipedia used as source [6], not acceptable. No STK files mentioned in appendix? Screenshots present. Users: operator/customers partially addressed. Mission duration 5 years, EOL drag sail — good. Ground comms frequency addressed via STK access report. Launch site/vehicle addressed. Orbit elements given. Manoeuvres addressed (none except EOL). Structure good, exec summary present. References cited.

C1: mission, rationale, single spacecraft, users — operator mentioned (Australia ground facilities) but customers vague (marine scientists). Adequate-to-accomplished; give 7? Users partially. I'd say 7 borderline; give 6? "Accomplished" requires all requirements high standard; customers not clearly identified. Give 6 (adequate high).

C2: comprehensive but with technical errors (inclination wrong, latitude wrong, contradiction retrograde/prograde, "low resolution which is also desirable"). Adequate: 5-6. Give 5.

C3: conclusion decent, specific. 7.

C4: presentation good, figures labelled somewhat (some captions odd), Wikipedia source, minor grammar issues. 7.
